fee_notes: Royalty is the greater of $900/month or 5% of Gross Revenue. Marketing Fund Fee is not currently required; if established in the future, franchisee must contribute 1%-2% of Gross Revenue on 90 days' prior notice. POS System Support Fee is $80-$180/month. Gift Card Program Fee is $10/month. Sticker of the Month Fee is $30-$50/month. Social Media Marketing Service Fee is $10-$25/month. Additional fees include: Product Purchases ($0-$72,500), Violation Assessments ($500/day), Finance and Administrative Fee (varies; $75/occurrence in 2025 before interest), Administrative Assessments ($25/violation), various training fees, Transfer Fee ($11,000), Audit Fee ($1,000-$5,000), Interim Management Fee ($500/day), Renewal Fee ($5,000), Post Termination Gross Revenue Fee (5% of competitive business revenue), Liquidated Damages (2x total royalty fees paid in preceding 12 months), Private Offering Fee ($10,000+), and Indemnification.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fees | The greater of $900 or 5% of your Gross Revenue per month. | 1st day of each month after the Rocket Fizz Shop opens for business. | "Gross Revenue" means all revenues from sales of any nature or kind from the Rocket Fizz Shop...
Marketing Fund Fees | We do not currently require you to pay a Marketing Fund Fee. If and when we establish a Marketing Fund, you must contribute 1% to 2% of your Gross Revenue as a Marketing Fund Fee as we specify. | 1st day of each month. | We may elect to establish a Marketing Fund in the future on 90 days' prior notice.
Product Purchases from us and/or R3 Distribution | $0 to $72,500 | Monthly, bi-monthly, weekly or on COD basis...
POS System Support Fees | $80 to $180 per month | 1st day of each month.
Violation Assessments | $500 per day plus our out-of-pocket expenses...
Finance and Administrative Fee | Varies... currently 10% annually in California. In 2025, before any interest was added, the Finance and Administrative Fee was $75 per occurrence.
Administrative Assessments | $25 per violation.
Pre-Opening Additional Initial Training Fees | $500 per day per additional trainee...
Post-Opening Initial Training Fees | $1,500 per week for each trainee...
Post-Opening Additional/Remedial Training Fees | $500 to $700 per day...
Post-Opening Inspection Fee | $500 per re-inspection.
Insurance | Amount of unpaid premiums and our out of pocket costs...
Transfer Fee (Franchise Agreement) | $11,000.
Non-Cash Payment System | All costs associated with non-cash payment systems.
Default Reimbursement | Our costs and expenses from your default.
Audit | Cost of audit (estimated to be $1,000 to $5,000) plus interest...
Interim Management Fee | $500 per day plus the actual out-of-pocket expenses...
Renewal Fees & Extension Fees (Franchise Agreement) | $5,000.
New Product and Supplier Testing | Cost of inspection and actual cost of testing; up to $1,000 must be paid as a deposit.
Franchise Conference Fee | Up to $1,000 per person.
Payment for point of sale advertising material... | $0 to $2,750.
Post Termination Gross Revenue Fee | 5% of all revenue derived from the operation of the competitive business.
Indemnification | All costs including attorneys' fees.
Gift Card Program Fee | $10 per month.
Sticker of the Month Fee | $30 to $50 per month.
Social Media Marketing Service Fee | $10 to $25 per month.
Private Offering Fee | $10,000 or such greater amount...
Liquidated Damages | An amount equal to twice the total royalty fees paid (or if unpaid, payable) by you during the 12 months immediately preceding the effective date of termination.
